title: Fix empty rules + Date-based equity plot
description: Lowered per-symbol thresholds (PHASE3_PER_SYMBOL_MIN_TRADES 50→15, PHASE3_PER_SYMBOL_MIN_RETURN 3.0→1.5) to prevent empty rule rejection on small pools. Added _try_lean_fallback function to Phase 3 — the most lenient fallback path that picks top-2 pool rules by min(train_ret, val_ret) without gate_positive_good or team backtest, used when both per-symbol greedy and _try_global_pool_fallback fail. Updated plot_equity_curve to use Entry_Time as date-based x-axis with mdates.DateFormatter when available, falling back to Trade # when missing or all-NaN. Added outputs/evaluator_clean/README.md documenting the folder's purpose. Created 2 new test files (17 total tests) covering the date-axis behavior and lean fallback logic.

verification.diff_scope: git diff main...HEAD --stat  # 6 files changed, 539 insertions(+), 5 deletions(-)

notes_for_reviewer: _try_lean_fallback deliberately bypasses gate_positive_good, _simulate_team, and val_floor check — this is the most lenient fallback path, designed for the current tiny 4-9 rule pool. Phase 4 risk optimization and Phase 5 evaluator still filter weak rules.
The date-axis implementation sorts by Entry_Time before plotting, ensuring chronological order even if trades interleave across symbols. Falls back to Trade # when Entry_Time is missing or all-NaN.
No unused imports or dead code paths were identified for removal in the modified files.
